g.text: octane-assistant · every vendor, integration, MCP and datastore that touches the core
branch feature/Mytrion @ 0c1a2b75 · verified against source 2026-08-02 · supersedes ONBOARDING.md counts
Who talks to Mytrion · all served same-origin from one container
no auth headers — signed in the body
Telegram · Claude Agent SDK · Node 22 + tsx, no build step
Claude subscription OAuth token pool, not an API key · sonnet-4-5
runs as a second process inside the same production container
Despite the name: zero Groq — it is the OpenAI Responses API
Fork of agent-gateway · 16 Vitest files · 15 skill dirs
No deploy path — but seed:support-kb imports its KB corpus
only free-form SQL path to DWH
One self-client OAuth app, per-service refresh tokens
Outbound channels and robotic process automation
How a card actually moves money · Mytrion never calls WEX directly
the real EFS / CMP path — and the busiest write surface after Deluge
money codes · card status · limits · funds · balances
carrier groups, transactions, driver card scope
the underlying fuel-card network behind EFS
Replicas and warehouses · never a migration target
DWH_DATABASE_URL · read-only session · 30 s statement timeout
pool max 5, shared with servercrm + BI · 9 domain query modules
SSH tunnel on :3307 · READ ONLY session · 60 s execution cap
Admin → CMP schema browser · ? placeholders, not DWH-portable
Migrations only ever touch the app Postgres.
MYTRION_OPS_DATABASE_URL · pgvector / pg16 · :5433 local · the only writable store
tenant_id on 76 of 88 tables — isolation is application-level, enforced in repos/. No RLS in the migration chain.
Never drizzle-kit push. Schema change → pnpm db:generate → commit .ts + .sql + _journal.json together.
Open trap: drizzle.config.ts still omits support_bot_knowledge_articles.ts and verification_sales_responses.ts → generate would emit DROPs.
Production is one Render web service, one image, one container
plan starter · health /health · Dockerfile is what actually builds
one image → one container → TWO processes:
1 node dist/server.js — API :3001, CRM at /, mini-app at /mini-app
2 agent-gateway — only when Telegram + Claude tokens are both set
pg-boss workers & crons — FF_JOBS_ENABLED left unset
pnpm dev:all → API :3001 · web :5173 · CMP tunnel :3307
octane-assistant · Fastify 4 · TypeScript strict, ESM · audiences: internal · partner · customer
requestContext → auth → apiKeyAuth → combinedAuth → RBAC · helmet · CORS · rate-limit 120/min · websocket · multipart · SPA static
REST /v1 · WebSocket /v1/realtime · SSE /chat/stream + /agent · 81 typed touchpoint keys · signed webhooks
toolDispatcher → ToolRegistry (riskClass gate) · 11 department agents on deepagents + LangGraph · agentic RAG + CRAG web fallback
the only place raw DB access is allowed · ctx: TenantContext is the first argument · tenant filter first in every .where()
departmentFilter(ctx) in repos/knowledgeRepo.ts is the single RAG chokepoint — reused verbatim, so a reformulated query cannot widen access.
Agent authority is narrowed, never widened: allDepartmentAccess dropped, bypassRbac deleted, riskClass re-checked at every dispatch.
